description:
Hushfacebook v0.18.1 targets Facebook 584.0.0.51.56 (com.facebook.katana), the newest release.

Settings are easier to get around now. Every section opens right on the main page, the rows are more compact, and Pause sits in the top bar. Feed videos can get their own play button, and new switches hide the comments under feed posts or the WhatsApp button on reels. Settings also come in Traditional Chinese. If Facebook crashed at startup for you with Newest reels first on, that's fixed too.

This release has 102 patches. Built by GitHub Actions from commit e47742c14366, with build provenance attested. The patches weren't applied to a Facebook APK in CI.

Review diagnostic reports for private data before sharing them.

Needs Morphe Manager 2.0.0 or newer. Patch the arm64-v8a bundle of Facebook 584.0.0.51.56, build 475817393. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a Facebook APK. Keep the manager's existing signing key when updating.
